headline: Nation’s Taxmen Now Require Mandatory ‘Arrest Consultation’ With Local Chai-Wala Before Proceeding With Any Legal Detentions
body:
“I told the inspector that the guy he wanted to nab hasn't paid his GST, but he’s currently midway through a cutting chai and a conversation about the upcoming cricket match, so he’s technically immune until the cup is empty,” said a local tea stall owner near the tax office.

“The tax inspector came to my shop yesterday, but he just sat on the bench for two hours waiting for me to finish my third cup because he wasn’t sure if the ‘arrest aura’ was correct before noon,” remarked a neighborhood hardware store manager.

“I’ve started carrying an extra packet of tea leaves in my pocket specifically for this reason, because if I sense an investigation coming, I just brew a pot and suddenly I have diplomatic immunity,” noted a local garment retailer.

“My brother was almost detained for a minor paperwork error, but luckily, he offered the tax officer a bun-maska, which counted as a ‘soft-detention compromise’ and we just went home,” explained a nearby college student.

“It’s a win-win for everyone, really; the taxmen get their caffeine fix, we keep our freedom, and the GST portal gets to rest while we discuss the weather,” claimed an auto-rickshaw driver waiting at the stand.
caption: New GST policy requires taxmen to secure a ‘Chai Clearance’ before any official arrests. The local tea stalls are now the most powerful legal entities in the country. #GST #ChaiLife #TaxReform #Bureaucracy (satire)
igHook: Would you trust your local chai-wala to decide if you get arrested? Tag a friend who needs a tea break.
imagePrompt: A candid, medium shot of an outdoor tea stall on a busy city street corner with people in semi-formal office attire standing around plastic tables holding glasses of tea.

sourceHeadline.title: GST Council meeting today: Cutting across divide, 5 big states oppose end of taxmen’s arrest powers
